def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    pts8 = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 8]
    other = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 8)]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in pts8), max(r for r, c in pts8)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in pts8), max(c for r, c in pts8)
    lengths = []
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        cs = [c for rr, c in pts8 if rr == r]
        if cs:
            lengths.append(max(cs) - min(cs) + 1)
    for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
        rs = [r for r, cc in pts8 if cc == c]
        if rs:
            lengths.append(max(rs) - min(rs) + 1)
    scale = math.gcd(*lengths)
    mr0, mr1 = min(r for r, c in other), max(r for r, c in other)
    mc0, mc1 = min(c for r, c in other), max(c for r, c in other)
    n = max(mr1 - mr0 + 1, mc1 - mc0 + 1)
    mark = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
    for r, c in other:
        mark[r - mr0][c - mc0] = grid[r][c]
    rotated = [[mark[n - 1 - c][r] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, c in pts8:
        i, j = (r - r0) // scale, (c - c0) // scale
        color = rotated[i][j]
        if color:
            out[r][c] = color
    return out
